test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which of the following years was 'Purna Swaraj' accepted as an Indian National Congress goal at INC's Lahore session?
solution:
The correct answer is **__1929.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Purna Swaraj:**

 
 
• **The Indian National Congress on 19 December 1929, passed 'Purna Swaraj' at its Lahore session. Hence, Option 4 is correct.**
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru** was the president of the Indian National Congress during the Lahore session.
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru hoisted** the national flag of India on** 31 December 1929** on the banks of the **Ravi **river as a part of 'Purna Swaraj'.
 
• A public declaration on 'Purna Swaraj' was made by Congress on** 26 January 1930.**
 
• Congress asked the people of India to observe the 26th of January as Independence Day since 1930 (later it changes and made 15th August as the official Independence Day.)
 
• The** declaration of 'Purna Swaraj' **was passed due to the breakdown of negotiations between **Indian Freedom Fighters and the British government over the question of dominion status for India.**
 
• To commemorate the** 1930 declaration India** decided to celebrate **January 26** as **Republic day.**
 
• **Lord Irwin **was the viceroy of India during the** declaration of 'Purna Swaraj'.**
